craft_notes: Sthāyin: throb-meditation (the body throbs; speech answers). Rows: row 3 (ask→dwell). Close: speech (antarnadantī as landing: inward-resounding). Rejected: 'vibrate' for throb — kept throb (spandase as pulse, Kaula word); print variant mānini — L3/L4 keep mālini (Tantraloka 15.333 grounds; variant lives in lore/argmap).

lines: Māyā, Vidyā, Mātṛkā, Mālinī — pulsing in each body as knowing's own spark:
how dwell on you, self-flashing? I dwell on you as inward-murmuring speech.
l4.sanskrit_cite: māye vidye mātṛke mālini tvaṃ | kāye kāye spandase citkalātmā | dhyāyeyaṃ tāṃ tvāṃ katha svasphurattāṃ | dhyāyeyaṃ tvāṃ vācamantarnadantīm
